name: Question Palm
description: Strike with a palm that asks the foe a plain question with the weight of the blow.

name: Answer Guard
description: Meet a thrust with the answer that closes it and slide it clear of the body.

name: Paired Reading
description: Read the foe from both courts at once and hold the point on which they agree.

name: Cross Question
description: Press a foe from two sides with questions of the body until his stance contradicts itself.

name: Joint Finding
description: Make a finding with both courts together and lay it on the foe as a weight.

name: Twin Edge
description: Cut with both edges of the court at once so the guard meets two truths and holds neither.

name: Cleared Dock
description: Clear the floor of the court of every falsehood so the foe stands alone and open.

name: Standing Proof
description: Drive proof through a guard as a narrow stroke that cannot be argued aside.

name: Twin Exposure
description: Hold both courts open through the qi field and cancel every cover and glamour on the ground.

name: Joint Ruling
description: The school's closing stroke; both courts give one ruling and the blow that carries it lands as law.

name: Mirror Core
description: Polish the core to a mirror that returns each motion exactly as it was made.

name: Lens Palm
description: Gather the qi in the palm like light in a lens and strike at the point of focus.

name: Hawk Lens
description: Look through the hawk's lens and see each foe's worth and wound as clearly as a coin.

name: Reflect Step
description: Step into the foe's reflection and out of it on the side he did not guard.

name: Self Shown
description: Show the foe a flash of himself in the mirror until he stares at it and forgets to move.

name: Burnished Ward
description: Hold a ward of polished qi that sends back a little of each blow it meets.

name: Focus Ray
description: Pass a ray of clear qi through the lens to burn a hole in a guard.

name: Hawk Sweep
description: Sweep the lens across the ground and strike every foe it finds out of his disguise.

name: Mirror Verdict
description: Hold up the great mirror and let a foe see his guilt and fear until his arms fail.

name: Core Revelation
description: Open the core as a mirror through the qi field and cancel all false shapes before it.

name: Mirror Held Up
description: The school's closing stroke; the mirror is held to the foe and the blow follows what it shows.

name: Spoken Strike
description: Say the blow in one word and land it as the word ends.

name: Troth Shield
description: Speak the oath of the guard and let the shield rise on the final syllable.

name: Word Ear
description: Listen to a foe speak and catch the word where his voice and his qi part.

name: Spoken Pace
description: Pace forward at the speed of speech and cover the gap by the end of a sentence.

name: Binding Sentence
description: Say a sentence that names the foe's limbs as still and the qi makes it so.

name: Retracting Lie
description: Force a foe's lie back into his mouth as a sting of broken qi.

name: Truthful Shield
description: Speak a wall into being from facts only and hold it as long as the words stay true.

name: Declared Cut
description: Declare the cut and make the declaration good with a stroke through the guard.

name: Declared Fact
description: State the foe's defeat as a sworn fact and let its weight settle on his every limb.

name: Pledge Honoured
description: Make a sworn blow good in a single stroke that lands exactly where the oath named.

name: Speech Ear
description: Make the whole field a listening ear and mark each false word spoken in it.

name: Word And Stroke
description: The school's closing stroke; word and blow are one act and the foe cannot answer either.

name: Candid Core
description: Open the core wide and let its clear qi fill the limbs without any held back.

name: Reckoning Palm
description: Strike with a palm that settles an account in a single plain blow.

name: Bearing Reading
description: Read the heading of every body on the ground from the one clear point of the core.

name: Bare Account
description: Lay a foe's account bare and break the poise he built on false entries.

name: Account Ward
description: Hold a ward of plain qi from the core that hides nothing and yields to nothing.

name: Debt Called
description: Call in what the foe owes for his deeds and let the debt bear him down.

name: Clear Rend
description: Rend a guard open with a thrust of core qi that follows no false line.

name: Unwalled Reach
description: Open the reckoning across the ground and strike every foe who has hidden behind a claim.

name: Core Accounting
description: Pass the whole account of the core through the field onto one foe past every defence.

name: Final Reckoning
description: The school's closing stroke; the reckoning is called and the foe is held while the blow falls.
